recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If future local builds show flag-column mojibake despite the current Gradle/Kindling UTF-8 configuration, investigate the active Kindling publisher/tooling rather than the removed DSTU1-era Java files.
issue_request: FHIR-5972 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from DSTU1 reporting strange characters in the Flag column of generated structure views on a Windows local build.
initial_application: Jira comments identify the cause as a local Java code-page/encoding problem and say it was fixed in SVN revision 5447. The corresponding git-svn commit e9a5c6012a8360d509be847ff3c7a77e6da955f7 changed several old Java generator/publisher writers from platform-default encoding to UTF-8.
additional_context: The old Java publisher files patched in 2015 are no longer present. The current build uses the Gradle Kindling dependency, gradle.properties sets -Dfile.encoding=UTF8, shared generated-page templates declare text/html; charset=utf-8, and source/formats.html contains the intended UTF-8 flag glyphs. A later same-symptom FHIR-ips issue, FHIR-16150, is outside this core branch scope and recorded that the problem was no longer present in that current build.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The historical fix was applied, the vulnerable checked-in publisher code path has been removed/refactored out of core, and the current active source/build configuration already preserves and declares UTF-8 for pages that display the flag glyphs.
